title: The timeless ritual
story_seed: The protagonist joins a new real estate organization, but gets embroiled in a cult that spans centuries. He mistakenly activates a device that starts shifting the entire building through time. The building changes appearance and purpose based on the time period, but the structure remains the same. The workers in the building stay the reincarnations of current workers. Our player has to find artifacts to fix this  and complete the ritual before the timelines merge and collapse. The story starts normally, then the protagonist moves to each timeline once, then they have to visit each timeline to collect the pieces of the artifact and solve puzzles in hilarious situations. The first timeline is the modern timeline, the second timeline is a medieval timeline where magic is present, the building acts as the palace of A king (currently CEO) with the harem (all employees), the last timeline is the 1960's timeline, just starting with technology, the building is a college dorm, the CEO is the warden and the students are employees again. The characters other than the protagonist may have different names that have same meaning in different timelines. The story will have a crisis where altering something in the past will be key to unlocking the ritual in the future.
genre: Occult Time-Travel Thriller with Dark Comedy
tone: Surreal tension laced with anachronistic irony, escalating from mundane corporate dread to cosmic horror
